title: MobileNavigationQAPatternSchema
Mobile Navigation Viewport Overflow Pattern
observation: Horizontal flex navigation headers containing >3 links overflow and clip out-of-bounds on viewports < 640px wide unless explicitly collapsed or hidden via media query breakpoints.
rootCause: Applying desktop inline flex layout to header navigation without media query breakpoint for small viewports.
reusableRule: Headers on marketing/landing pages MUST apply @media (max-width: 640px) to hide secondary links or collapse into a mobile drawer while keeping primary CTA visible.
verificationCriterion: Browser viewport inspection at 320px, 375px, and 640px showing zero horizontal scrollbar.
